Specification_Engineering_Prompt.Q: Produce the five-artifact Specification Stack for the Invoice Intake Service defined below, then implement and verify it task by task. Author CONSTITUTION.md first, then SPEC.md, PLAN.md, TASKS.md, and EVALS.md, committing each to version control before implementation begins. Resolve every Open Question with the author, or record the working assumption, before finalizing SPEC.md.

specification_stack.artifact: SOX audit trail policy, approved stack (Python 3.12, FastAPI, PostgreSQL 16), test coverage floor, review gates.
The nine anatomy sections below, requirements carried verbatim.
Components, database schema, ERP integration contract, migrations, risks.
Atomic tasks, each citing the requirement IDs it implements and its verification hook.
The EX traces as the seed dataset, a failure taxonomy, and the extraction accuracy threshold.

anatomy.Objective: Accept supplier invoices (PDF and e-invoice XML), validate them against vendor master data, and queue approved invoices for ERP payment. Actors: Supplier, AP Clerk, Finance Manager. Value: touchless processing of clean invoices with a SOX-compliant audit trail. Non-goals: payment execution, vendor onboarding, OCR model training.
anatomy.Contextual_Constraints: Python 3.12, FastAPI, PostgreSQL 16. No additional runtime dependencies without sign-off. The service boundary ends at the ERP payment queue.

Data_Contracts.contract: JSON schema: invoice_number (string, 1 to 64 chars), vendor_id (string, references vendor master), currency (ISO 4217 code), line_items (array, minimum 1), total (decimal, 2 places).
JSON schema: status (accepted | rejected), reason_codes (array of string), requirement_ids (array of string).
UNRESOLVED: the schema file vendor-master.json was referenced but not provided. See OQ-001.

requirement.rationale: Extraction is the entry condition for every downstream behavior.

Functional_Logic.requirement: When an invoice is submitted through the portal or by email, the Invoice Intake Service shall extract invoice number, vendor, currency, line items, and totals.

requirement.rationale: Vendor validation is the stated control against paying unknown parties.

Functional_Logic.requirement: When extraction completes, the Invoice Intake Service shall validate the invoice against the vendor master data.

requirement.rationale: Duplicate payment is the highest-cost failure in accounts payable.

Functional_Logic.requirement: If a submitted invoice carries an invoice number and vendor pair that already exists, then the Invoice Intake Service shall reject the submission with reason code DUPLICATE.

requirement.rationale: Extraction failures need a human path; silent drops violate SOX traceability.

Functional_Logic.requirement: If extraction fails on any required field, then the Invoice Intake Service shall place the submission in the AP Clerk review queue with the failed fields named.

requirement.rationale: Segregation of duties above the clerk limit is a SOX control.

Functional_Logic.requirement: While an invoice total exceeds the AP Clerk approval limit, the Invoice Intake Service shall withhold the invoice from the payment queue until a Finance Manager approval is recorded.

requirement.rationale: Queueing is the service's terminal success state.

Functional_Logic.requirement: While an invoice is validated, When its required approval is recorded, the Invoice Intake Service shall queue the invoice for payment in the ERP.

requirement.rationale: The audit trail must hold for every path, not only the happy path.

Functional_Logic.requirement: The Invoice Intake Service shall write an append-only audit record for every state change of every invoice.

requirement.rationale: Stated as a need but unquantified; held in draft.

Functional_Logic.requirement: When an invoice is submitted, the Invoice Intake Service shall complete extraction and validation within a bounded time. UNQUANTIFIED: see OQ-003.

requirement.rationale: Stated as a need but undefined; held in draft.

Functional_Logic.requirement: While an invoice meets the archival condition, the Invoice Intake Service shall archive it. AMBIGUOUS: see OQ-002.

anatomy.AI_Behavior_and_Guardrails: Tool permissions: repository read and write, test execution, database migration in development only. Response format: every change references the requirement IDs it implements. Escalation: any change touching audit or approval logic requires human review before merge; confidence below high on a SOX-relevant decision escalates to the author. Prohibited: inventing or hallucinating data, schemas, vendors, or requirements.
anatomy.Safety_and_Compliance: SOX scope: the approval and audit paths. PII: vendor bank details are masked in logs and in the review queue. Access controls: AP Clerks read their own queue; Finance Managers read all queues. Audit log structure: actor, action, invoice id, timestamp, prior state, new state. Human approval gate: REQ-APPR-001 is never automated.

Acceptance_Criteria.criterion: Submitting the same invoice number and vendor pair twice yields exactly one stored invoice and one DUPLICATE rejection.
An invoice one cent above the AP Clerk limit never reaches the payment queue without a Finance Manager approval record.
Every validated and approved invoice appears in the ERP payment queue exactly once.
In a full happy-path run, the count of audit rows equals the count of state transitions.

anatomy.Validation_and_Evals_Plan: Unit tests per extraction field and validation rule. Integration tests across the portal, email, and ERP boundaries. End-to-end tests for the happy path plus the three EX traces. Adversarial regression: a malformed PDF, a forged duplicate with altered whitespace, and the approval limit boundary. EVALS.md thresholds: extraction accuracy at or above 99 percent on the seed dataset; zero silent failures across the regression suite.

Open_Questions.question: vendor-master.json was referenced but not provided. The VendorMaster data contract and REQ-VAL-001 cannot be finalized without it.

"Processing must be fast" carries no number. Proposal: 95th percentile extraction plus validation under 30 seconds; confirm or replace. REQ-PERF-001 is held in draft until quantified.
